text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an all-out run, Sweep Tosho cast a 
spell on Kawakami Princess and the 
others—a spell that made them burn with 
the desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carried by the feelings stirred by her 
magic, the Umamusume jumped over the fence 
alongside Kawakami Princess and landed on 
the turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither of them wants to surrender their 
dream; both feel a fierce desire to win 
the race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho suggests everyone compete 
together, deciding to see the effects of 
her magic at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
